In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], [[Shoon-mi Esh]] tried to '''assassinate''' [[Nom Anor]] so that he could assume control of the role of [[Nom Anor|Yu'shaa]] the [[Prophet/Legends|Prophet]]. However, with the help of [[Kunra]], Anor escaped with his life while Esh and his lackeys were [[Death/Legends|killed]].
